description: Schema for Neural-Compressed Markdown (NCM) tags used by context-compressor.

O.label: Objective
O.description: The current primary goal of the session or project.

S.label: Status
S.description: Current progress or state of the task.

D.label: Decision
D.description: A key decision made that must be preserved.

K.label: Knowledge
K.description: Critical facts, context, or data points.

N.label: NextStep
N.description: The immediate next action to be taken.
